relationships.subject: PBN Calca neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, by directly stimulating Calca neurons, we demonstrate that Calca neuron activity is sufficient to drive nociplasticity.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that, while activation of PBN Calca neurons is sufficient to drive nociplasticity, the Calca gene products, including CGRP, do not play a necessary role in this model of nociplastic pain.

relationships.subject: nitroglycerin
relationships.evidence_quote: NTG administration dramatically increased the basal fluorescence level of most of the Calca neurons compared with vehicle administration

key_findings: PBN Calca neuron activity is necessary for neuropathic allodynia and sufficient to drive persistent nociplasticity.
CGRP/Calca gene products are dispensable; NTG increases Calca neuron activity and recruits more responsive neurons.
